children: An AI data API startup has raised $9 million in a round led by General Catalyst, with Orange Collective and Robinhood Ventures also participating. According to ChainCatcher, the company’s single API provides search, scraping, crawling and monitoring features to help AI agents access and use internet data.
The API has been adopted by more than 800 customers. SV Angel, Eniac VC and Pioneer Fund also participated, along with angel investors Paul Graham, Guillermo Rauch and Rick Rubin.

title: AI Data API Startup Raises $9 Million in Round Led by General Catalyst
